exercise.rubric: <font color="#000000">Match the words and their definitions.</font>

questions.sentence: <font color="#000000">To run or organize a meeting. </font>[chair]
<font color="#000000">The record of what was said or agreed in a meeting. </font>[minutes]
<font color="#000000">Someone who does a job if the main person becomes unavailable. </font>[backup]
<font color="#000000">A general word for numbers or calculations. </font>[figures]
<font color="#000000">A suggested price that is given at the start of a project. </font>[quotation]
<font color="#000000">Chief Executive Officer (the most powerful manager in a company). </font>[CEO]
<font color="#000000">The thing that you want to achieve at the end of a project. </font>[objective]
